summary: @or-sdk/permissions-lambda preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 728 KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 728 KB single-line obfuscator.io-style payload (rotated string-array `WV8StW`, custom-alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`, `_0x*` mangled identifiers, `@bun @bun-cjs` header) with runtime-assembled string fragments (email-shaped and URL-shaped tokens) that cannot be resolved without executing the decoder. The advertised purpose of the package is a ~20-line AWS Lambda invocation wrapper at `dist/cjs/index.js`, which has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime, and no source for `math_init.js` exists in `src/`. The CHANGELOG points to an internal OneReach GitLab (`gitlab.internal.onereach.io`), while the shipped `preinstall` + obfuscated blob are absent from that source tree — consistent with a malicious release of an otherwise internal `@or-sdk/*` package. The alien-runtime fetch is used solely to execute the shipped opaque blob, evading Node-based scanners and hooks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
